_comment: Template for the environment's flat JSON secret (app_secret_name in main.tf). Copy OUTSIDE the repo, fill every <FILL-*>, upload with: aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id <app_secret_name> --secret-string file://<copy>.json - then delete the copy. Never commit a filled version. DATABASE_URL user/password come from the RDS-managed master secret (terraform output db_master_user_secret_arn); terraform output db_endpoint ALREADY includes the port. Use scripts/fix-secret-database-url.sh build to format it. Every key here must also appear in web_secret_keys or mcp_secret_keys, or ECS never injects it.
INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAIL: <FILL - first admin's Google Workspace email, in an allowed domain>
